decisions.reason: Changing the CTA redirect destination to a Facebook account page does not alter the embedded product video's inclusion or source.
The CTA destination decision does not change the landing page's visual style, thematic elements, or photo-selection requirement.
Redirecting the CTA to Facebook does not affect customization of the reference design with the client's product pictures.
The CTA redirect destination does not change the product description, target customers, messaging emphasis, or marketing purpose.
The CTA's Facebook redirect is distinct from the shareable link customers use to access the landing page, so the existing access requirement remains unchanged.
